title: Gabi-Monads
summary: We study gabi-monads on skew-closed categories, extending the gabi-algebras of Berger, the second author, and Vercruysse beyond the linear case. Our main reconstruction theorem identifies gabi-monad structures on a monad with skew-closed structures on its Eilenberg--Moore category for which the canonical forgetful functor is strict closed. We compare this notion with closed monads in the sense of Kock, showing that in representation-theoretic cases these notions are quite different.
